claims.summary: Fallen Empires 1994-11-01, credited artist Heather Hudson.

Pay {1}, tap, and sacrifice Aeolipile to activate it; the ability deals two damage to any target on resolution. Aeolipile can activate the turn it was cast because it is a noncreature artifact, barring other restrictions. Removing the artifact in response cannot undo an already paid sacrifice cost. One Plains supplies the generic {1} for Aeolipile. Tap and sacrifice the artifact as additional activation costs, target an opposing White Knight (2/2), and on resolution deal two damage to destroy it. Destroying Aeolipile after activation is impossible; it already left the battlefield as a cost.
